$$

$$
y=3.
$$

To find the coordinates of the point, we inspect its position along the $x$- and $y$-axes.

* The point is $4$ units to the *right* of the origin, in the *positive* direction of the $x$-axis. So, its $x$-coordinate is $4.$

* The point is $3$ units *below* the origin, in the *negative* direction of the $y$-axis. So, its $y$-coordinate is $-3.$

Therefore, the coordinates of our point are $(4,-3).$
